name: What interior remodeling questions should I ask a contractor before signing?

mainEntity.name: What interior remodeling questions should I ask a contractor before signing a contract so I can avoid change orders and delays?
mainEntity.text: What interior remodeling questions should I ask a contractor before signing a contract so I can avoid change orders and delays?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before signing, ask questions that reveal how the contractor actually runs the job. The most important topics are scope, exclusions, allowances, permit responsibility, schedule, change orders, and communication. Homeowners should ask who handles design coordination, how selections are approved, what happens if hidden issues are found, and how payment draws are tied to progress. It also helps to ask for example timelines, recent comparable projects, and clarification on cleanup, dust control, site protection, and disposal. Many remodel disputes happen because the homeowner assumed an item was included when it was only discussed verbally. A strong contractor will explain assumptions clearly and put them in writing. The goal is not just to compare price, but to compare how complete and transparent each proposal really is.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask how the contractor handles permits, allowances, change orders, inspections, scheduling, and hidden conditions. Also ask who manages design selections, what is excluded from the bid, how communication works, and whether the estimate includes demolition, disposal, protection, and cleanup. Clear answers should be written into the contract.
